title: Florida Pasture Cube v1.0: field-level time series of persistent pasture fields in Florida, 2016-2026

creators.name: Rodrigues, Hugo
creators.affiliation: University of Florida, Institute of Food and Agricultural Sciences, Range Cattle Research and Education Center, Ona, Florida, USA

description:
Field-level, 5-day time series for 81,203 persistent pasture fields in Florida (1.20 Mha), 1 January 2016 to 29 October 2026 (791 periods): HLS v2.0 optical reflectance and indices with observation counts and gap-filling flags, Sentinel-1 VV and VH backscatter, and PRISM weather. Each field carries soil (gNATSGO), terrain (3DEP: slope, TWI, HAND) and wetland (C-CAP) attributes and quality flags. Labels: US Drought Monitor (county-week), NASS pasture condition (state-week) and hurricane tracks and landfalls. Per-acquisition long tables keep the provenance of every composite. Three benchmark tasks with fixed splits and baseline results are included.

Files: each directory of the release is one zip (stored, not recompressed); unzip them in one folder to recover the release layout. cube.zarr.zip holds the Zarr store contents at its root (unzip cube.zarr.zip -d cube.zarr, or open it with zarr's ZipStore). DATASHEET.md documents composition, missing data and uses; SHA256SUMS lists checksums of every unpacked file and DEPOSIT_SHA256SUMS those of the uploaded files.
notes: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2016-2026). Source data and their attributions are listed in DATASHEET.md. Field geometry derives from Florida Department of Revenue parcel data; no owner information was downloaded or is distributed. PRISM values within about six months of the retrieval date are provisional; 2026 landfalls are derived from working best tracks.
